title: Good Samaritan: The Shocking Truth of the Parable #shorts

top_liked.author: @andrew_9875
top_liked.text: Wait a minute. Wasn't Jericho destroyed way back in the old testament and joshua put a curse on whoever rebuilt the city? If so, how did it get rebuilt into a well-known city in jesus' day?

top_liked.author: @pwl1012
top_liked.text:
This is an interesting take and makes us wonder how ancient peoples saw “the whole world”. It was only after the great age of exploration that we really understood and conceptualise ideas about globalisation.

It is clear from many NT passages that Jesus’ focus was on redemption…
